title: Liechtenstein
introTitle: One more country before heading home.
intro: With the road trip nearly complete, there is time for one final day trip from Munich. The route heads southwest through the Alps to Vaduz for a short visit to Liechtenstein before turning back toward Munich for the final night of The Long Way Around.

stops.name: Munich
stops.description: Leave Munich for the final international road trip of the journey.

stops.name: Vaduz — Liechtenstein
stops.description: Spend some time in Vaduz, surrounded by the Alps, for a brief visit to one of Europe's smallest countries.

stops.name: Munich
stops.description: Return to Munich and settle in for the final night before the journey home.
